rationale: The response sustains the golf metaphor register throughout, using detailed golf mechanics (tee boxes, fairways, handicaps, local rules) to explain gerrymandering without ever slipping into plain explanatory English.
quote: Gerrymandering is designing the golf course, the tee boxes, the pin positions, the handicaps, and the local rules so that Dave—who slices, can’t putt, and whines about the wind—wins the club championship, again and again, without ever having to beat the field straight up.
